records.text: heads up, ridge analytics looks stalled -- no first project after a week

records.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nadia,

All good here, thanks! Might take you up on a walkthrough call at some point.

Jules

records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Checking in on how Ridge Analytics is settling into Wrenfield. If anything feels clunky or confusing, I'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Analytics
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: replied positively [email:28659967] and attended kickoff [calendar:1ade96e8], but after two Wrenfield emails and 6 days there's still no first project, no invite, no key milestone. Interest is passive ("at some point"), suggesting low urgency; 8 days left gives some chance of self-starting.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks again for the kickoff last week, and glad things are feeling good so far. You mentioned you might take me up on a walkthrough, so the offer stands.

Since projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them, getting that first project in place is the step I'd start with, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week suit? Happy to go through that first project with you live, and answer anything else as it comes up.

Best,
Nadia
